lines.t: In the stillness before the voice
The air trembles with mercy unknown
Shadows whisper what's to come
And my soul asks will I be undone
The storm is near, the veil grows thin
And I can feel heaven waiting within
Break me open, burn me clean
Consume the darkness inside me
Let the fire fall, holy and true
I surrender all to you
I build my pride in towering walls
Stone by stone I defy the cold
Now ashes rise where I once stood tall
And I hear your whisper through it all
In the thunder I see your face
Mercy falling like rain
And grace break me open
Burn me clean
Take the weight that's killing me
Let your life, Lord, every wound
I surrender all to you
Tear me down, yet lift me high
Through the fire I come alive
Love so fierce it purifies
In your arms the old me dies
No fear remains, no shame endures
Only love, eternal and pure
Every tear I've cried you kept
Each one a melody of regret
But your hands turn sorrow to song
You call me home
Where I belong
The fire that broke me now makes me whole
Your glory written in my soul
Break me open
Make me new
Breathe in me
I breathe in you
All I am and all I'll be is love reborn eternally
The horizon burns gold, the night is no more
Our eyes in Your light Reborn, restored
Love is the fire that remakes me
Yahushua, forever You save me
Thank you.
